title: TransitionOutcome
description: Outcome of a continuity-layer transition. Game-only currency changes are represented as economic_events and must be routed through EconomyLedger.mutate(); deprecated currency_delta values are non-authoritative compatibility metadata only.

economic_events.description: Typed game-only economic deltas to reconcile through the ledger; not applied directly by consumers.

currency_delta.description: Deprecated compatibility field. It must never be treated as authoritative; use economic_events.
